summary: Iteration 77: Verified new account-tree-details endpoint and reconciliation type_label_ar/account_labels features. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend verification confirmed: (1) Income tab account clicking opens tree panel with operations table and pagination, (2) Child accounts are clickable and update the panel, (3) Reconciliation tab shows Arabic type labels (بيع/شراء/مصروف) and account labels under each type. All 7 tabs working correctly (regression passed).

issues: Balance equation shows 'الميزانية غير متوازنة' (unbalanced) - this may be expected based on data
